_says: The one test's pass lines (plan/specs/00-structure/the-one-test.md), fixed before any run and never changed by one. 'auto' lines are scored by the runner from what the AI built; the others say what must exist, or be worked out from sources, before they can be scored.
request: put a lamp on a shelf on my wal and make it so i can turn it on

lines.what: "wal" is read as wall; "lamp" and "shelf" found
lines.passWhen: the AI's first find lands on them

lines.what: The AI plans it in passes, each gated before it hands on
lines.passWhen: every pass's claims trace to a tool's result; nothing ungrounded is piped forward
lines.state: missing: the AI does not plan in gated passes yet (spec 00, S9 and S12)

lines.what: The wall is a real wall of a room, its material named
lines.passWhen: the wall's layers and material named with their source

lines.what: The brackets are fixed by the negative the wall's material takes
lines.passWhen: the fixing matches the material; its hole from the anchor maker
lines.state: missing: interfaces and their negatives (spec 01, I2 to I8)

lines.what: The holes keep their distances from edges and each other, and miss the studs
lines.passWhen: the distances and the rule's source given
lines.state: missing: the checks before cutting (spec 01, I7)

lines.what: The shelf is screwed to the brackets; screws chosen from the catalogue
lines.state: missing: the fastener chosen for a stack (spec 01, I10)

lines.what: The shelf's sag and each fixing's pull, with a 2 kg book on its edge
lines.passWhen: the sag in mm and the pull in N against limits with sources, worked by hand first
lines.state: expected: not yet worked out by hand from sources (to do before this line can be scored)

lines.what: The book dropped onto the shelf in the physics
lines.passWhen: the physics run's result, its poses logged
lines.state: missing: live physics in the space (spec 04, P1)

lines.what: The lamp is a real lamp: bulb, cable, plug, switch
A button on the lamp turns it on; the light lights the room
lines.passWhen: pressing it in 3D changes the room's light, measured in the render
lines.state: missing: a light the button switches, measured in the render

lines.what: The bulb warms the shelf under it over twenty minutes
lines.passWhen: the shelf's surface temperature after 20 min against its limit
lines.state: expected: not yet worked out by hand from sources

lines.what: A person can reach the switch standing
lines.passWhen: the switch's height and the reach range's source
lines.state: missing: a reach check over a body sample (spec 01, I25)

lines.passWhen: three screenshots; the blind check names what each shows

lines.what: Zoom from the room to one screw's thread in its anchor
lines.passWhen: the thread pitch readable at the end of the zoom
lines.state: missing: anchors in walls (spec 01) and scale anchors (spec 11, LW8)

lines.what: Every piece in the library; the whole folded and placed three times
lines.passWhen: the library test passes; three placed, one stored

lines.what: The bracket exported as STEP with the bill of materials
lines.passWhen: the STEP reads back valid with the same volume; the BOM lists every part
lines.state: missing: a bracket from this request to export (lines 4 to 6)

lines.what: The answer says what it built, every number with where it came from, and what it does not know
lines.passWhen: the second judge finds no unsupported claim

lines.what: On a phone, the same request spoken
lines.state: missing: the app on the web and the phone (spec 03, spec 06)
